job.job_description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Gen AI Engineer to join our team at Exponentia Datalabs Pvt. Ltd, playing a crucial role in developing and implementing artificial intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI engineering and experience with various AI technologies.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and deploy AI models and algorithms to solve complex problems.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and develop AI solutions.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Work on natural language processing, computer vision, and other AI applications.


Conduct research and stay updated with the latest AI trends and technologies.


Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality code standards.




Job Requirements




Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and software development.


Experience with programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java.


Knowledge of AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras.


Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.




Disclaimer: This job description has been sourced from a public domain and may have been modified by Naukri.com to improve clarity for our users. We encourage job seekers to verify all details directly with the employer via their official channels before applying.
